bf16_proof: Every finite nonzero BF16 raw pair is classified by sign XOR, 8-bit significand product, and scale-exponent sum. Significand and exponent fields are independent; the scanned normal-normal, subnormal-normal, and subnormal-subnormal families cover every reachable finite class. Zero, Inf, and NaN category/sign combinations are separately enumerated.
sequence_space_note: All scalar input pairs are covered. Arbitrary accumulator sequences are unbounded and are verified separately with bounded exhaustive and adversarial long-K tests.
